name: Cord marking
summary: Twisted cord or a cord-wrapped stick is rolled or pressed into the wet clay wall. It leaves a dense texture of fine ridges.
how: Twist two strands of plant fibre into a cord.
Wind the cord round a stick or lay it flat on the wet wall.
Roll or press it across the wall in rows or bands.
Dry the pot and fire it in a bonfire.

origin.note: Jōmon potters press cord into the wet wall of the first Japanese pots.

adoptions.via: Jōmon potters mark the whole wall of a deep pot with cord and name the period after the pattern.
